Alger, 9 août 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Algé: Algiers, August 9, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Algérie Poste has launched a national beach cleanup campaign in partnership with the Agence Nationale des Déchets. The initiative, which began in Zeralda (wilaya of Algiers), mobilizes employees and their children to promote environmental responsibility.
Une mobilisation citoyenne pour la propr: A citizen mobilization for coastal cleanliness
Dans le cadre de sa démarche de responsa: As part of its corporate social and environmental responsibility approach, Algérie Poste has initiated a national beach cleanup campaign. The first stage took place in Zeralda, a coastal municipality in the wilaya of Algiers, where the company's workers and employees participated in volunteer work. This action symbolizes the institution's commitment to responsible environmental behavior.
L’initiative, coordonnée avec l’Agence N: The initiative, coordinated with the Agence Nationale des Déchets, is part of a drive to raise awareness about the protection of marine ecosystems. Employees' children were also involved in this approach, highlighting the importance of teamwork to preserve the environment. According to the publication, this campaign will continue in the coming weeks in the various coastal states of the country.
La campagne a suscité des réactions sur: The campaign has sparked reactions on social media. Some internet users praised the postal workers' commitment, such as Mohamed Sami who pointed out that "Algerian postal workers participated on Friday in the beach cleanup so that they can be a model for their fellow teachers and other workers."
